description: This file contains utility functions for handling URIs and paths, including conversion, parsing, and manipulation of URI paths and segments.

methods.name: pathToUriPathSegment
methods.description: Converts an OS path to a URI path segment format with no leading/trailing slashes.

methods.name: getCleanUriPath
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the path component from a URI or plain path.

methods.name: findUriInDirs
methods.description: Finds a URI within a list of directory URI candidates, returning relative path and directory info.

methods.name: getUriPathBasename
methods.description: Returns the filename or last segment of a URI path.

methods.name: getFileExtensionFromBasename
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: getUriFileExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension of a URI.

methods.name: getLastNUriRelativePathParts
methods.description: Gets the last N parts of a URI's relative path.

methods.name: joinPathsToUri
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments to a base URI, encoding segments appropriately.

methods.name: getShortestUniqueRelativeUriPaths
methods.description: Computes shortest unique suffix paths for a list of URIs within directory candidates.
